extraction.Name: Louisa Sanovia
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee to her allotment, for the reason that she did not want to pay the taxes, but the Indian Agency told her that she would have to accept it, so she did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1921, she sold her 320 acre allotment to J.L.Cozet, of Martin, South Dakota, for $5000.00, receiving $1000.00 in cash, and he has never paid anything since
extraction.Buyer: J.L.Cozet, of Martin, South Dakota, for $5000.00
extraction.Occupation/Income: supported by her husband, who is a gardener and a little lease money she receives off of land formerly owned by her first husband, William Fire Thunder
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent; health is poor, having heart trouble; has two minor children who have good health; has never received any help from the County or Government; first husband was William Fire Thunder; document sworn November 17, 1928
